decisions.statement: A tree carrying compiled-bundle markers is refused as upstream.
A tree with no upstream manifest is refused.
A tree missing a file the pin requires is refused.
A manifest carrying no AddOnVersion line is refused.
A tree whose AddOnVersion differs from the pinned release is refused.
A checkout whose commit cannot be read is refused.
A checkout at a commit other than the pinned commit is refused.
A checkout with local edits is refused.
A refusal says which of the rulings the tree failed.
A tree is held to a release by its AddOnVersion rather than by a line count.

definition: the ruling on whether a checkout really holds the pinned upstream LibSets
